actions.action: Delete expired records before serving requests
actions.mechanism: A monotonic five-minute deadline determines freshness; source failures never extend retention.
actions.implementation: Stamp successful insertions with expiry. Schedule deletion and recheck expiry on every read. Return 503 when an expired record cannot be replaced.
actions.check: With a fake clock and timed-out source, requests at five minutes return 503; the expired record is absent.
actions.risk: Scheduler delays require read-time enforcement, not timer-only freshness checks.

actions.mechanism: A single admission lock prevents concurrent insertions from exceeding the 100-record cache limit.
actions.implementation: Under the lock, remove expired entries, then evict the least recently used entry before inserting at capacity. Failed fetches trigger no capacity eviction.
actions.check: Race 150 distinct successful fetches: occupancy never exceeds 100. During failure-only traffic, unexpired entries remain until their deadlines.
actions.risk: Least-recently-used eviction can discard valuable records during sequential scans.

actions.action: Bound source waits and suppress repeated failures
actions.mechanism: Timeouts and a circuit breaker turn a slow-source outage into predictable, explicit responses.
actions.implementation: Set a source timeout and failure threshold. While the breaker is open, serve only unexpired hits; return 503 with Retry-After for misses. Permit one recovery probe.
actions.check: Inject sustained timeouts: misses finish within the configured timeout, open-state requests skip fetching, and expiration deletion continues.
actions.risk: An excessive cooldown delays detection of source recovery.

actions.action: Cache only an approved public-record projection
actions.mechanism: An explicit field allowlist excludes private data rather than trusting entire source payloads.
actions.implementation: Request only approved public fields from a public-only endpoint; validate before admission. Reject unexpected fields without logging payloads. Return 502 if no valid cached record exists.
actions.check: Inject an unexpected sensitive field: no payload is cached, returned, or logged, and an existing unexpired record remains unchanged.
actions.risk: Projection may omit distinctions callers require; document the response schema.
